course.a: No. Shortlisted is a placement program — like having your own placement cell. There are no classes or syllabus; the focus is interviews, applications, and getting you hired.

batch.a: After you subscribe, you are automatically assigned to the current open batch (max 12 students). A dedicated coordinator is assigned to guide your batch through the placement process.

jobs.a: Jobs are posted on the DISHA platform by companies. DISHA admins assign relevant openings to your Shortlisted batch based on your profile and readiness.

support.q: What kind of support can I expect?
support.a: Your batch coordinator helps with applications, interview prep, and tracking. You also get access to live sessions, peer support, and updates on shortlist and offer status in your dashboard.

refund.a: Subscription terms are shared at checkout. Contact support for exceptional cases — we are happy to clarify before you pay.
